2607.05902.title: From Textural Counterpoint to Feature Encoding: A Multi-Dimensional Machine Representation Study of Haydn's "The Lark" Integrating Electroacoustic Analysis
2607.05902.paper_summary: Chamber music, as a highly precise multi-part interactive system, contains a logic of "role assignment and dynamic interaction" that provides an extremely valuable blueprint for exploring human-computer collaborative composition paradigms. Addressing the lack of role perception capabilities in existing deep music generation models during polyphonic interactions, this paper conducts an interdisciplinary analysis of Haydn's String Quartet in D Major, The Lark (Op. 64, No. 5). We propose a novel research path: "Classical Morphology Qualitative Analysis-Electroacoustic Quantitative Measurement-Machine Representation Reconstruction." The study first utilizes auditory analysis to dissect the counterpoint morphology of the leading voice and the underlying groove in the first movement. Subsequently, it introduces spectrum and dynamic feature analysis tools from a Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) to translate subjective auditory perception into objective, measurable physical parameters. Building on this, the paper introduces a fundamentally new approach to low-level computer feature extraction: completely abandoning the traditional mechanical quantization grid, introducing Event-based Timestamps to record the duration of micro-timing, and transforming acoustic features into an independent "Role-Aware Encoding" as an aesthetic heuristic mechanism (a phenomenological anchor). This study not only completes the logical loop spanning classical analysis, electronic music mapping, and AI symbolic generation but also establishes a profound theoretical foundation-from the perspectives of interactive aesthetics and media philosophy-for constructing human-computer collaborative music systems imbued with "social attributes" and "otherness awareness."
2607.05902.paper_summary_zh: 室內樂作為一種高度精確的多部互動系統，包含了「角色分配與動態互動」的邏輯，為探索人機協作作曲範式提供了極具價值的藍圖。針對現有深度音樂生成模型在多聲部互動中缺乏角色感知能力的問題，本文對海頓的D大調弦樂四重奏《雲雀》（作品64，第5號）進行了跨學科分析。我們提出了一條新穎的研究路徑：「古典形態學質性分析-電子聲學量化測量-機器表徵重建。」研究首先利用聽覺分析來剖析第一樂章中主導聲部的對位形態及其底層節奏。隨後，引入數位音頻工作站（DAW）中的頻譜和動態特徵分析工具，將主觀的聽覺感知轉化為客觀、可測量的物理參數。在此基礎上，本文引入了一種根本全新的低階計算特徵提取方法：完全放棄傳統的機械量化網格，引入基於事件的時間戳來記錄微時間的持續時間，並將聲學特徵轉化為獨立的「角色感知編碼」，作為一種美學啟發機制（現象學錨點）。本研究不僅完成了涵蓋古典分析、電子音樂映射和AI符號生成的邏輯循環，還從互動美學和媒介哲學的角度建立了構建具備「社會屬性」和「他者意識」的人機協作音樂系統的深厚理論基礎。
